comment: Weekly town events. They play when their part starts and Shift the week's signature (DESIGN.md Section 10: 'letting the deli freezer fail adds Cold; helping the blacksmith keep the forge lit adds Heat').

event.title: The pep rally banner
event.text: On the front steps, the pep rally banner has come loose and hangs upside down: YLLAR PEP. Kara is trying to fix it alone and failing.

choices.label: Help her fix it (1 AP)
choices.result: Right side up. Kara thanks you three times. The air feels a bit less glaring.

choices.label: Leave it upside down
choices.result: Nobody fixes it. All day, people walk under it and feel slightly worse.

event.title: Practice
event.text: At the field, Coach Byrne's megaphone squeals feedback every time anyone talks. The squad is getting louder to compensate.

choices.label: Unplug it
choices.result: Blessed silence. Coach nods once.

choices.label: Turn it up
choices.result: Dex howls into it. The bleachers rattle. Something under them rattles back.

event.title: Gary's freezer
event.text: Gary is wrestling with the deli's walk-in freezer. It's frosted shut from the OUTSIDE. "Kid. Help me with this or go get the blacksmith."

choices.label: Help Gary chip it open (1 AP)
choices.result: Together you crack the ice. The freezer sighs. Gary pats your shoulder twice.

choices.label: Let it be
choices.result: The freezer stays sealed. All night, the deli hums a little colder.

event.title: The forge goes cold
event.text: The forge's fire gutters out in the middle of the afternoon. The blacksmith stares at it like it betrayed him. Jake is panicking.

choices.label: Work the bellows until it catches (1 AP)
choices.result: It catches. The blacksmith grunts. It's the most grateful grunt you've ever heard.

choices.label: Ask what's wrong with it
choices.result: "It went cold for a reason once. Now it's remembering."

event.title: The closed wing
event.text: Dr. Reyes is standing at the closed wing's door with a key she hasn't used in years. "I need someone to hold the light. Someone who's already seen worse."

choices.label: Hold the light
choices.result: The door opens. The hall beyond is full of empty beds made with hospital corners. Somebody has kept them made.

choices.label: Tell her to wait for daylight
choices.result: She opens it anyway, later, alone. You hear about it from Patti.

event.title: A broken-down truck
event.text: A produce truck has died in the middle of Main Street. The driver, Mo, is staring at the engine like it owes him money.

choices.label: Help push it to the curb (1 AP)
choices.result: It moves. Mo pays you in cash and one very bruised apple.

choices.label: Direct traffic around it
choices.result: Three honks, one wave, zero accidents.

event.title: A lost dog
event.text: A scruffy dog with no collar follows you for two blocks, then sits and stares at the woods.

choices.label: Take it to the vet at the hospital
choices.result: Patti knows the dog. 'That's Biscuit. He's been missing since Tuesday. Same day as the Hendersons' kid.'

choices.label: Follow where it's looking
choices.result: At the treeline the dog whines and won't go further. Neither, you decide, will you.

event.title: High score battle
event.text: Jon and Dex are locked in a battle for the top score on the old fighting cabinet. They both look at you.

choices.label: Back Dex
choices.result: Dex wins by a frame. He will never let anyone forget it.

choices.label: Back Jon
choices.result: Jon wins and explains frame data for nine minutes.

choices.label: Challenge the winner (1 AP)
choices.result: You lose. Respectably. They both respect it.

event.title: Something moved
event.text: A curtain in the abandoned mansion's upstairs window moves. There's no wind. It moves again.

choices.label: Watch for a while
choices.result: A shape at the window. It's holding a lantern. Kelly has a lantern like that.

choices.label: Leave. Now.
choices.result: You leave. You don't look back. Mostly.

event.title: Sparks at the market
event.text: A stall's grill flares up at the farmers market. Flames lick the awning.

choices.label: Smother it
choices.result: Out. Your sleeve smells like smoke all day.

choices.label: Get the extinguisher from the deli
choices.result: Gary hands it over without a word. Then a sandwich, also without a word.

event.title: The station opens
event.text: The train station's lights are on for the first time in years. A traveling vendor is setting up a table of odd trinkets.

choices.label: Browse
choices.result: "Everything here has a story," she says. "Most of them end badly. That's why they're cheap."

choices.label: Ask about the trains
choices.result: "The last train out ran thirty years ago. Same night the fountain did."

event.title: Rehearsal in the square
event.text: Mr. Mustard has the drama club rehearsing in the town square during class. He sees you. He does not seem surprised.

choices.label: Join in
choices.result: You play a tree. A very good tree. Mr. Mustard nods.

choices.label: Pretend you're on an errand
choices.result: "Of course you are," says Mr. Mustard, to no one.

event.title: Power cut
event.text: Every light in town goes out at once. For eleven seconds, the only light is from the woods.

choices.label: Count the seconds
choices.result: Eleven. Exactly eleven. Like it was timed.

choices.label: Check on your guardian
choices.result: They're fine, holding a flashlight that doesn't work either.

event.title: The founder's exhibit
event.text: The museum's new exhibit: the town founder's desk, his journal behind glass, and a model of the fountain with a crack in it.

choices.label: Read the journal page
choices.result: 'It must run once every thirty years. If it does not, we pay another way.'

choices.label: Study the model
choices.result: The crack in the model matches the one on the real fountain. Exactly.

event.title: A town meeting
event.text: The Mayor holds an emergency meeting about 'recent events'. Half the town is there. Nobody says the word 'woods'.

choices.label: Say the word 'woods'
choices.result: Silence. Then twenty people start talking at once.

choices.label: Listen
choices.result: The Mayor checks his phone twice. Both times, Mr. B is standing at the back.
